title: brain config
description: Settings of the brain module: Obsidian vault location, project catalog, document sync and notes.

vault_path.description: Root directory of the Obsidian vault; a leading ~ is expanded. Machine-wide: a project file cannot set it.

catalog.description: How a project is matched to its folder in the vault.

projects_dir.description: Folder with the control notes of projects, relative to the vault root.

docs.description: Document sync between a project and its folder in the vault.

enabled.description: Whether document sync is on for the project.

direction.description: Default direction of the document sync.

patterns.description: Glob patterns relative to the vault project folder and to the project root.

notes.description: Notes written to the vault for ecosystem events.

enabled.description: Whether notes are written for events.

folder.description: Folder of the notes inside the project folder in the vault: a relative path without .. and outside the synchronized folders.

fallback_folder.description: Folder of the notes from the vault root for events whose project is not found in the vault.
